skills.name: Fire Punch (火拳)
skills.description:
Yixuan launches a 2-strike attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 40% of his ATK with each strike.
When Yixuan is in his Divine Manifestation form, this skill changes to Flame Bound. ;Divine Manifestation (昭神形态/昭神形態) :'''General, Status''': Yixuan unleashes his fire powers, greatly increasing his skills and inflicts Burning Heat when dealing damage. ;Burning Heat (灼烧/灼熱) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Max of 3 stacks. At the start of turn, deals indirect damage equal to 40% of Yixuan's ATK and recovers his HP by 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Flame Bound (焰缚/焔縛)
skills.description: Yixuan attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 130% of his ATK.

skills.name: Bathed in Fire (火浣重重)
skills.description:
When Yixuan deals damage, he gains 1 Bathed in Fire stack, up to a max of 25 stacks. Each time he gains 5 stacks, his move bar is increased by 20%.
When he has max stacks; all control effects are removed from him, his HP is recovered by 80%, his move bar is increased by 100% and he immediately enters his Divine Manifestation form. ;Bathed in Fire (火浣) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Increases ATK and DEF by 2%, max of 25 stacks. ;Divine Manifestation (昭神形态/昭神形態) :'''General, Status''': Yixuan unleashes his powers as the aspect of Fire, greatly increasing his skills and inflicts Burning Heat when dealing damage. ;Burning Heat (灼烧) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Max of 3 stacks. At the start of turn, deals indirect damage equal to 40% of Yixuan's ATK and recovers his HP by 50% of the damage dealt.

upgrades.text: '''Bathed in Fire''': ATK and DEF increases to 3%.
'''Bathed in Fire''': ATK and DEF increases to 4%.
When receiving damage, he gains 1 Bathed in Fire stack.
Exclusive effect. When receiving lethal damage, he becomes immune to the damage and gains 25 Bathed in Fire stacks.

skills.name: Thousand Flaming Punches (焰力千钧/灼力千釣)
skills.description:
Yixuan attacks all enemies dealing damage equal to 130% of his ATK. Then deals an additional attack to a random enemy, dealing damage equal to 130% of his ATK.
When Yixuan is in his Divine Manifestation form, this skill changes to a stronger version of the skill. ;Divine Manifestation (昭神形态/昭神形態) :'''General, Status''': Yixuan unleashes his powers as the aspect of Fire, greatly increasing his skills and inflicts Burning Heat when dealing damage. ;Burning Heat (灼烧) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Max of 3 stacks. At the start of turn, deals indirect damage equal to 40% of Yixuan's ATK and recovers his HP by 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Thousand Flaming Punches (焰力千钧/灼力千釣)
skills.description: Yixuan launches a 2-strike attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 80% of his ATK with each strike. Then deals an additional 3-strikes to random enemies, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage for the AOE strikes increases to 85%.
Damage for the additional strikes increases to 110%.
Damage for the AOE strikes increases to 90%.
Damage for the additional strikes increases to 120%.
